cmo_details.subject: POLICIES, STANDARDS AND GUIDELINES FOR BACHELOR OF SCIENCE IN ENTERTAINMENT AND MULTIMEDIA COMPUTING (BS EMC) PROGRAM

program_specifications.degree_name: Bachelor of Science in Entertainment and Multimedia Computing (BSEMC)

specializations.name: Game Development
specializations.objectives: to prepare students to be game development professionals with specialized knowledge, competencies and values in designing, developing, and producing digital games and / or tools, and in managing game development projects for various applications.
careers: Associate Business Development Specialist for Entertainment and Multimedia Industries

specializations.name: Digital Animation-Technology
specializations.objectives: to prepare students to be digital animation professionals who are equipped with both creative and technical knowledge, skills, and values in conceptualizing, designing and producing animation products and solutions, and in managing such projects over different technology platforms.
careers: Associate Business Development Specialist for Entertainment and Multimedia Industries
